verdict.rationale: Penpot ships an official MCP server that lets users "connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away" from an external AI agent, so they can operate design files with natural-language prompts. However, this works only through a bring-your-own agent/LLM, and there is no evidence of a native in-app natural-language command interface. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command surface, documentation of which operations can be driven by prompts, independent or hands-on corroboration that prompt-driven operation works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Choose your agent, connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away!
In Penpot, design is expressed as code, so AI agents can easily read and interact with your design files creating high-fidelity artifacts.
Penpot enables plenty of AI workflows, from generating editable design structures to connecting product logic, tokens, and implementation.
